name: Viking 1
note: The first fully successful landing on Mars. The lander worked until November 1982.

name: Viking 2
note: The second Viking lander. It worked on the northern plains until April 1980.

name: Mars Pathfinder
mission: Mars Pathfinder and the Sojourner rover
note: A lander with Sojourner, the first rover on Mars, which drove about 100 m.

name: Spirit
note: A rover planned for 90 sols that worked for six years and drove about 7.7 km.

name: Opportunity
note: A rover planned for 90 sols that worked for 14 years and drove about 45 km.

name: Phoenix
note: A lander on the arctic plains. It worked for about five months, until the polar winter.

name: Curiosity
note: A rover that landed at Bradbury Landing and explores the layered rock of Mount Sharp.

name: InSight
note: A lander that listened for marsquakes until December 2022.

name: Perseverance
mission: Mars 2020 Perseverance and the Ingenuity helicopter
note: A rover that landed at Octavia E. Butler Landing and collects rock cores. It carried the Ingenuity helicopter.

name: Zhurong
mission: Tianwen-1 lander and the Zhurong rover
note: China's first Mars rover. It drove about 1.9 km before going into hibernation in May 2022.
